FloPlast half round pipe clips are durable uPVC components designed to securely fasten 68mm downpipes for drainage systems. These robust black uPVC clips offer a practical, easy to install solution for both new-build and refurbishment projects, ensuring stable pipework. Ideal for external rainwater drainage on various buildings, these reliable clips are compatible with most major manufacturers' pipe systems, providing secure support without the need for lubrication. This 10-pack of 68mm pipe clips facilitates efficient installation for trade professionals.
